## Fidelity gaps

1. **Structural mismatch:** Prototype exporter writes five logical sheets; Commander template is one combined **Тексты** workbook layout.
2. **Row model mismatch:** Template rows pair keywords and ads in one flat table; ORCA model is hierarchical (campaign → group → keywords/ads).
3. **Header translation only:** `workbook-writer.js` may rename logical headers when `commander-header-map-v0.json` is loaded — **does not** write into template cell positions.
4. **Extension encoding:** Fastlinks/callouts use combined multi-value columns, not prototype `extensions` sheet rows.
5. **Match type:** ORCA `match_policy` has no verified Commander column — phrase text may embed match semantics.

## Transport risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| Operator imports prototype XLSX expecting Commander layout | **Fail-closed docs** + fidelity notes — prototype is **not** template-shaped |
| Header rename without column position mapping | Human review; no auto-import |
| Cyrillic header drift vs Direct UI | Re-run `template-reader.js` after template refresh |
| Large **Регионы** sheet accidentally modified | Exporter v0 does not write reference sheets |
| Combined extension cells | Manual Commander edit or future adapter — **not** v0 |
